description: Corrected semantic keyword annotations for the saved 30-cell E5 run. Raw answers and the original qa_questions.json remain unchanged.

questions.question: How does the Transformer compute attention, and why does it replace recurrence and convolution?
questions.expected: Scaled dot-product attention with multi-head projection; parallel computation and global dependencies without recurrence.

questions.paper: Quantum Computing in the NISQ era and beyond
questions.question: What defines NISQ technology and what is its central limitation?
questions.expected: Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum devices without quantum error correction; noise limits circuit depth.

questions.paper: Large Language Models Encode Clinical Knowledge
questions.question: What is MultiMedQA and how did Flan-PaLM perform on the MedQA benchmark?
questions.expected: MultiMedQA combines seven medical QA datasets; Flan-PaLM reached 67.6% on MedQA, surpassing prior models.

questions.question: Which three independent ontologies subdivide the Gene Ontology?
questions.expected: Molecular Function, Biological Process, and Cellular Component.

questions.paper: Unified Growth Theory Contradicted by the Economic Growth in Europe
questions.question: Why does historical European economic growth contradict Unified Growth Theory?
questions.expected: The source reports hyperbolic European growth without the predicted stagnation-to-growth transition; this conflicts with the theory's staged escape narrative.

questions.question: Which physical contributions govern the response of precipitation extremes to climate change, and which contribution is robust in the general case?
questions.expected: Thermodynamic moisture/saturation-vapor-pressure changes are robust and often near Clausius-Clapeyron scaling; dynamics and precipitation efficiency also matter in particular regimes, so the review does not identify one universal dominant factor.

questions.paper: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
questions.question: What is MameLoshnLM and what parameter scale does it have?
questions.expected: The first open-source 8B-parameter Yiddish language model with an evaluation benchmark.

questions.paper: Oxygen redox in battery cathodes: A brief overview
questions.question: How does oxygen redox contribute to the capacity of battery cathodes?
questions.expected: Lattice oxygen participation enables extra capacity beyond transition-metal redox in Li-rich cathodes.

questions.paper: MLP-SLAM: Multilayer Perceptron-Based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
questions.question: What problem of visual SLAM in dynamic environments does MLP-SLAM address and how?
questions.expected: Dynamic objects degrade V-SLAM; an MLP (multilayer perceptron) filters dynamic features for robust localization.

questions.paper: Strategies for tumor elimination and control under immune evasion and chemotherapy resistance
questions.question: What strategies for tumor control emerge under immune evasion and chemotherapy resistance?
questions.expected: Evolutionary/ecological dynamics inform combination, phenotype-guided, sequential and adaptive treatment strategies under immune resistance/evasion and chemotherapy resistance.
